questions.title: malloc Index Sequence Printer
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Use malloc to allocate n integers, fill arr[i] = i for i in [0, n), print them space-separated on one line, then free the array.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The integers 0 through n-1 separated by single spaces.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: calloc Zero Sum Verifier
questions.description:
Read an integer n. Use calloc to allocate n integers (which must all be zero), sum them, print the sum (which verifies calloc zero-initialized), then free.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The integer sum of all calloc-initialized slots (always 0).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000

questions.title: realloc Fibonacci Extender
questions.description:
Read an integer n (n >= 2). malloc an array of 2 integers and set arr[0]=1, arr[1]=2. Then realloc to n integers and fill arr[i] = arr[i-1] + arr[i-2] for i in [2, n). Print all n values space-separated, then free.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The first n terms of the sequence 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ... separated by single spaces.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 50

questions.title: malloc Free Sum Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer n followed by n integers. Allocate an int array of size n via malloc, store the inputs, print their sum, then free the array before returning.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
The sum of the n integers.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, -10^9 <= each value <= 10^9

questions.title: Sum of Squares Leak Free
questions.description:
Read an integer n. malloc an array of n integers, fill arr[i] = i * i, print the sum of these squares, then free the array. The free call ensures no memory is leaked.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The sum 0*0 + 1*1 + ... + (n-1)*(n-1).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Large Array Maximum Finder
questions.description:
Read an integer n followed by n integers. Allocate n integers on the heap via malloc (large datasets need heap allocation), find and print the maximum value, then free.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
The maximum value among the n integers.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^6, -10^9 <= each value <= 10^9

questions.title: Weather Sample Dynamic Allocator
questions.description:
A weather station records n temperature samples. Allocate n integers via malloc to hold the samples, then print the integer average (sum divided by n, truncated toward zero), then free.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integer temperatures.

Output Format:
The integer average of the n temperatures.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -10^9 <= each temperature <= 10^9

questions.title: Warehouse Zero Stock Counter
questions.description:
A warehouse creates a stock table of n slots, all initialized to 0 via calloc. Count how many slots are zero to confirm the zero-initialization, print the count, then free.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The number of zero-initialized slots (equal to n).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000

questions.title: Concert Seating Reallocator
questions.description:
A concert ticketing system starts with 2 reserved seats valued at 10 and 20. Read an integer m (m >= 2). Use realloc to extend the seating to m seats, then fill seats 2..m-1 with seat[i] = seat[i-1] + 10. Print all seat values space-separated, then free.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer m.

Output Format:
m space-separated integers: 10, 20, 30, ..., up to 10*m.

Constraints:
2 <= m <= 100

questions.title: Log Buffer Cleanup Reporter
questions.description:
A logging system allocates a buffer of n+1 characters via malloc, fills positions 0..n-1 with the letters 'A', 'B', 'C', ... (capital letters), null-terminates at position n, prints the buffer string, then frees the buffer and prints the word "freed".

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
Two lines: the buffer string, then the word "freed".

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 26

questions.title: Shopping Cart Sum Max Reporter
questions.description:
An online store reads n item prices into a dynamically-allocated cart via malloc. Compute both the total price (sum) and the highest single price (max), then print "<sum> <max>" on one line, then free the cart.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integer prices.

Output Format:
Two space-separated integers: total price and maximum price.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5, 0 <= price <= 10^9

questions.title: Student Marks Zero Init Average
questions.description:
A teacher records n marks into a table allocated with calloc (so all slots start at 0). Then read n marks and add each to its slot. Print the integer average of the marks, then free the table.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integer marks.

Output Format:
The integer average of the marks (sum / n).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5, 0 <= mark <= 100

questions.title: Sensor Buffer Capacity Doubler
questions.description:
A sensor logger starts with a buffer of n integers initialized as arr[i] = i + 1. Then a new size m is requested. Use realloc to grow (or shrink) the buffer to m. For new positions i in [n, m), set arr[i] = arr[i-1] + 1. Print all m values space-separated, then free.

Input Format:
Line 1: two integers n and m.

Output Format:
m space-separated integers 1, 2, ..., m.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= m <= 1000

questions.title: Triple Buffer Cleanup Reporter
questions.description:
An analytics tool allocates three separate buffers of sizes a, b, c via malloc. Fill buffer1 with i*i, buffer2 with i+1, buffer3 with i*2 (index i from 0). Print the three buffer sums space-separated, then free all three buffers in order.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated integers a b c.

Output Format:
Three space-separated integers: sum1 sum2 sum3.

Constraints:
1 <= a, b, c <= 1000

questions.title: Leak Safe Overflow Checker
questions.description:
A leak-safe calculator reads n, mallocs an array of n integers, fills arr[i] = i + 1, then computes the sum. If the sum exceeds 100, print "overflow"; otherwise print the sum. Always free the array before returning.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
The integer sum if it is at most 100, otherwise the word "overflow".

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000

questions.title: Large Dataset Sum Min Max
questions.description:
A data pipeline reads a large dataset of n integers (up to 10^6 values) via malloc. Compute the total, minimum and maximum values. Print "<sum> <min> <max>" on one line, then free.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integers.

Output Format:
Three space-separated integers: sum, min, max.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^6, -10^9 <= each value <= 10^9

questions.title: Dynamic Matrix Transpose Allocator
questions.description:
A linear-algebra tool reads an r x c matrix into a dynamically-allocated 2D array (an array of int* pointers, each row malloc'd separately). Compute and print the transpose as a c x r matrix (c rows, r columns per row). Free every row and both pointer arrays before returning.

Input Format:
Line 1: two integers r and c. Next r lines: c space-separated integers each.

Output Format:
c lines, each with r space-separated integers representing the transpose.

Constraints:
1 <= r, c <= 100, -10^9 <= each value <= 10^9

questions.title: Growing Stack Realloc Doubler
questions.description:
A stack machine starts with capacity 1 (malloc'd). For each of n pushed values, if the stack is full, double the capacity via realloc (using a temp pointer). After pushing all n values, print the stack contents from bottom to top space-separated, then free.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integers to push in order.

Output Format:
n space-separated integers representing the stack from bottom to top.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5, -10^9 <= each value <= 10^9

questions.title: Two Buffer Leak Free Pipeline
questions.description:
A two-stage pipeline reads n. Stage 1: malloc buf1 of n integers, fill buf1[i] = i + 1, compute sum1 = sum of buf1. Stage 2: malloc buf2 of n integers, fill buf2[i] = sum1 - buf1[i], compute sum2 = sum of buf2. Free buf1, then free buf2. Print "<sum1> <sum2>" on one line.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
Two space-separated integers: sum1 and sum2.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^6

questions.title: Large Frequency Mode Counter
questions.description:
A polling system reads n votes where each vote is an integer in [0, 100]. Use calloc to allocate a frequency table of 101 integers (all zero). Count occurrences. Print the value with the highest frequency (lowest value if there is a tie), then free the table.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer n. Line 2: n space-separated integers in [0, 100].

Output Format:
The value in [0, 100] with the highest frequency (ties broken by lowest value).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^6, 0 <= vote <= 100
